editorial:
Imagine being a teenager in a tiny town where everyone expects you to fail just like the rest of your family. That is exactly where you find Duane, a kid with huge dreams and very little luck. What starts as a petty fight at school turns into something way bigger when Duane decides to run for mayor. It is a classic underdog story with a weird twist. The vibe is quirky and funny, making you root for this kid even when he makes mistakes. You will feel like you are right there in Ridgeway, watching a teen try to take on the big shots who run the town.

The acting is surprisingly grounded, which makes the crazy plot twists feel more real. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the tension picks up once the crime family enters the picture. You get a great mix of small-town politics and actual danger. If you are into comedies that have a bit of a dark edge, you will love this. You should definitely try to find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best look, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. Adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is also a great move if you like owning hidden gems.
endingExplained: In the final act, Duane discovers that his quest for power accidentally put him in the crosshairs of a dangerous crime syndicate. After a chaotic showdown involving the corrupt police and the town's elite, Duane manages to expose the truth about the local government. He does not just win a political battle; he saves himself from the mob. The movie wraps up with Duane finally gaining the respect of his family and the town, proving he is not a failure.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves seeing a little guy take on a corrupt system.
